facts.claim: 作者开篇立论：一本正经的好笑话不如一个极烂的笑话
facts.quote: The only thing better than a good joke is a really, really bad joke.

facts.claim: 作者援引关于幽默正面作用的研究，称幽默能改善情绪乃至增强免疫系统
facts.quote: There has been endless research done into the positive effects of humour in social connections, improving one’s mood and even helping to boost one’s immune system.

facts.claim: 作者把好笑话比作独木舟：一件能把你从 A 点送到 B 点的实用工具
facts.quote: Think of it like a canoe: a functional item that does a job and gets you from A to B.

facts.claim: 作者交读书中收录约 700 个笑话，并声明其中许多并不好
facts.quote: There are 700-ish jokes in this book, and a lot of them aren’t any good at all.

facts.claim: 作者把书中的坏笑话分成三类：老套可预测、生硬难讲、故意为之
facts.quote: Some are corny and predictable, some are contrived and difficult, and others are wilfully bad.

facts.claim: 作者论证讲成一个烂笑话比讲成一个好笑话更需要智力
facts.quote: How unfunny a joke is can be hilarious; making a rubbish joke that gets a laugh is much more intellectually complex than a mere funny one.

facts.claim: 作者把坏笑话的“坏”追加为独木舟里的热水袋，声称它让整趟旅程更暖
facts.quote: if a joke is a canoe, the badness of a bad joke is a luxurious hot water bottle that makes your canoeing journey warmer and more pleasant.

facts.claim: 作者用 kayak/heat it 的双关收束全章，改写“having your cake and eating it”
facts.quote: Or, to put it another way, you can have your kayak and heat it too.

relations.relation: 作者先把好笑话定性为有用的工具（独木舟），以此为后文抬高坏笑话搭好对照基线。
relations.quote: So a good joke is useful. Think of it like a canoe: a functional item that does a job and gets you from A to B.

relations.relation: 作者不把坏笑话当缺陷，而当成叠加在笑话之上的额外一层体验。
relations.quote: But a bad joke brings a whole extra level to the experience.

relations.relation: 作者用第二人称与读者共享一条“生活法则”：听众的呻吟与狂喜本是同一件事。
relations.quote: People groan in agony, sure, but they also moan in ecstasy. They’re basically the same thing! A rule to live by.

relations.relation: 作者替讲笑话者辩护：明知烂还肯投入时间精力，这份胆量本身就是笑点。
relations.quote: The audacity or misguidedness of the teller putting time and energy into something so rubbish, the mismatch between a joyful delivery and a disappointed or angry response … How unfunny a joke is can be hilarious

numbers.meaning: 作者声称本书收录约七百个笑话
numbers.quote: There are 700-ish jokes in this book, and a lot of them aren’t any good at all.

numbers.meaning: 作者把书中坏笑话归纳为三类（老套可预测 / 生硬难讲 / 故意为之）
numbers.quote: Some are corny and predictable, some are contrived and difficult, and others are wilfully bad.
